newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks edge lower in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks edge lower in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong shares drifted lower in quiet London trading on Thursday, echoing losses in U.S. and UK stocks and a decline in U.S. Treasury bonds, traders here said.
"The T-bond was off and Hong Kong shares were called lower," said a trader with one leading investment bank.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 29.53 points or 0.24 percent at 12,444.03, extending a drop of 18.81 points in the Hang Seng index in the territory earlier today.
In quiet London trading the FTSE 100 was down 24.2 points at 4,004.2 by 1506 GMT, while the benchmark 30-year U.S. T-bond was down 5/16 at 98-21/32.
